about_the_game:
Emlis: A combat-driven metroidvania packed with secrets to uncover as you travel a corrupted world as a heroic slime.

Gameplay features

  • Explore unique zones

  • Solve navigational puzzles

  • Master combat abilities as you face a variety of enemies

  • Overcome tough boss battles

  • Decrypt secret languages as you collect hidden lore pages
